title: Book Two · Chapter 141: Two Places
story:
A few weeks after Ronan's birthday, Miss Wu brings a new plan to the reading activity. She writes READING MATERIALS GROUP on the board. Under it she writes TWO PLACES.

Ronan sits straighter. Leo puts his pencil down. Mei looks up from her page.

“Next term,” Miss Wu says. “Two pupils will become full members of this group. They will do regular work with the school's reading materials.”

“What will they do?” Leo asks.

“Each week, they will read notices and find the right information. They will explain arrangements to younger pupils and answer questions clearly.”

Ronan looks at TWO PLACES on the board. Many pupils are here today. Only two will get those regular jobs.

“Is it for the fastest readers?” someone asks.

“No. You need accurate work and clear answers. You must say when you need help.”

Miss Wu puts several old practice sheets on her table. None has a pupil's name on show.

“First, you can try some practice tasks. We will use those records to choose a short list. The pupils on that list can try for the two places. I will give you the full rules later.”

She holds up a materials room notice and asks a pupil at the back to be a visitor. The pupil pretends he needs a picture sheet on Monday.

Miss Wu explains the real opening day and the place to ask. The pupil asks a second question about returning the sheet. She finds the line and answers it.

“That is the sort of work,” she says.

Ronan can see himself at the desk. A new pupil asks a question. He points to the right line. No wrong Wednesday. No old sheet.

He wants the place so much that his hand tightens around his pencil.

“Can anyone from this activity try?” Mei asks.

“Yes. Practice comes first. You can practise with the group before anyone gets a full member's place.”

Leo nods. “I want to try.”

Mei says she does too. Ronan answers after them.

“I want to try.”

Jun stays quiet at the next table. When Miss Wu asks, he says he wants to know the time needed each week. He has another activity to consider.

The lesson moves to their usual pages. Ronan finds it hard to look away from TWO PLACES. He reads his first line twice and still cannot say it back.

Leo taps the edge of his paper.

“This place first.”

Ronan smiles. “I know.”

He begins again. The story has a woman, a basket, and one clear problem. TWO PLACES is still on the board. Ronan looks down at the story and follows the woman's next action.

By the end of the activity, he has finished one page. Miss Wu wipes the board clean. Ronan keeps the new plan in his head all the way home.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

full member＝正式成员；regular＝固定的、定期的；short list＝候选名单；arrangement＝安排。

## 理解问题

1. full members在这里做什么固定工作？将选几人？
2. 老师有没有当天公布完整选拔规则？

## 读句子

**Leo / puts / his pencil down.** Leo／放下／他的铅笔。
